learned.claim: v0.6.5: history rewritten (trailers stripped, 44 commits, 17 tags); provenance migrated to the enrichment overlay via enrich --mark-authorship; CodeMonk reports 44 agent / 0 human trailer-free.

git filter-repo's commit-map starts with a literal 'old new' header line: a naive parser turned it into a substring replacement that mangled prose (gold->gnew, holds->hnews). Parse hex-strictly and replace on word boundaries.
learned.evidence: tools remap script round 2; grep count 0 after revert

learned.claim: Post-rewrite repair order matters: revert corrupted files to HEAD first (filter-repo preserves file contents), then remap; state-plane at_commit anchors stay untouched because chain integrity is content-hashed, not git-anchored.
No more Co-Authored-By trailers in this repo's commits (operator rule); authorship travels in docs/metrics/enrichment.json instead.
